truth_boundary: All 270 facts concern SAMPLE-SYN-113, a synthetic demonstration case. The body declares CANDIDATE/SAMPLE status, all register rows are SAMPLE_UNVERIFIED, and REAL originals remain HOLD/UNKNOWN. No real Association roster, dates, attendance, consent, certificates, issuer replies, internship, questionnaire responses, scores, or approvals were used, asserted, or verified. Certificate items are self-report or in-scenario SIM comparison only; mechanism D is simulated practice with real internship at HOLD; improvement decisions are proposals with NOT ADOPTED status; proposed roles require authorization. This is a consistency audit of supplied synthetic documents only and is not formal Association acceptance, review PASS, or approval.
